event: 2025 ILCA U 21 Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: Before the hearing started BEL 225117 retired from Race 8.
Wannes Van Laer (coach of BEL 225117) and Danilo Jončić (member of International Jury) attended the hearing as observers.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: 30 m after rounding mark 2, ITA 211712 sailing downwind on starboard tack.
BEL 225117 also on starboard tack, 2 m clear astern and 1 m windward of ITA 211712.
BEL 225117 sailing faster bore away behind ITA 211712.
Contact occurred between the rudder of ITA 211712 and bow of BEL 225117.
ITA 211712 has damage to rudder’s upper plastic piece, that attaches rudder to the boat, so that rudder was detached from the boat.
conclusions: BEL 225117 clear astern failed to keep clear of ITA 211712 clear ahead, and broke RRS 12.
BEL 225117 did not avoid contact with ITA 211712 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
It was not reasonably possible for ITA 211712 the right-of-way boat to avoid contact with BEL 225117 when it became clear that BEL 225117 was not keeping clear. ITA 211712 did not break RRS 14(a).

ITA 211712’s score in race 8 was made significantly worse through no fault of her own by physical damage because of the action of BEL 225117 that was breaking RRS 12 and took the appropriate penalty. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(2) are met.
decision: The protest is upheld. Since BEL 225117 took an applicable penalty, she is not further penalized under RRS 60.5(c)(2).

Redress is given to ITA 211712. ITA 211712 is to be scored in race 8 points equal to the average of scores of days 4 and 5, rounded to the nearest tenth of a point (0.05 to be rounded upward), except race 8. No other boat’s score shall change.
